text: Pack a rain liner, waterproof gloves and an anti-fog insert for your visor.
Heavy rain: double your following distance and avoid painted road markings and metal plates.
Fog on the ghats: ride on low beam, hazard lights on when stopped, wear a hi-vis layer.
Night ride: check headlight aim, carry a reflective vest and a power bank.
Pre-dawn ride: clean your visor, use high beam only on empty roads, and watch for dogs and cattle on the road.
It's {ctx.weather.temp_c}°C — carry at least 1 L of water and take shade breaks.
It's {ctx.weather.temp_c}°C and colder on the ghat tops — add a thermal layer and neck warmer.
Golden hour ({derived.photo_target} at {derived.golden_moment}): reach the viewpoint 20 min early and carry a polariser / ND filter.
High landslide risk — check local news / traffic police updates for ghat closures before leaving.
Pillion on board: adjust rear preload and agree on tap signals before you set off.
Weekend crowds expected — leave early or expect slow traffic near the popular points.
